title: Our process — Supreme Art
description: How Supreme Art makes pharmaceutical folding cartons — from prepress and printing to die-cutting, folding, gluing and dispatch, all under one roof.
intro: Scroll through every stage — from the first proof to the flat-packed carton, each step happens under one roof in our Peshawar facility.

steps.title: Designing
steps.text: Your artwork and carton layout are designed and prepared by our in-house design team.

steps.title: Prepress & proofing
steps.text: Artwork, dielines and colour targets are checked and proofed before a single sheet runs.

steps.title: Board & materials
steps.text: Pharma-grade board and inks are received, batch-logged and stored ready for the job.

steps.title: Dies & plates
steps.text: Cutting dies and printing plates are prepared and mounted for the run.

steps.title: Offset printing
steps.text: The carton is printed across the sheet on our Heidelberg offset presses.

steps.title: Colour control
steps.text: Operators pull sheets and check colour against the approved target throughout the run.

steps.title: Die-cutting & creasing
steps.text: Every blank is cut and creased out of the printed sheet in one stroke.

steps.title: Folding & gluing
steps.text: Blanks are folded and glued into finished, flat-packed cartons.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.text: Finished cartons are inspected for print, dimension and finish before dispatch.

steps.title: Packing & dispatch
steps.text: Cartons are counted, packed and made ready for your filling line.

cta.heading: Have a carton to make?
cta.text: Send us your artwork or dieline — we'll come back with a quote and a timeline.
